subject: --parallel N : An unexpected condition occurred. Please report this bug to the authors of the irace package

messages.author: f50803d1a13ac08b
messages.subject: --parallel N : An unexpected condition occurred. Please report this bug to the authors of the irace package
parts:
Hello,
checking the scenario, in series it ends successfully, while trying the --parallel N option I get this error:

# Error occurred while executing targetRunner:
!is.null(.irace$cluster) is not TRUE
An unexpected condition occurred. Please report this bug to the authors of the irace package <http://iridia.ulb.ac.be/irace>

Am I doing it wrong?

I set the parallel option in scenario.txt file as follows: 

## Number of calls to targetRunner to execute in parallel. Less than 2
## means calls to targetRunner are sequentially executed.
parallel = 8

From the check output:

# Checking target execution.
# Executing targetRunner ( 2 times)...
11: traceback(1)
10: irace.assert(!is.null(.irace$cluster))
9: execute.experiments(experiments, scenario)
8: doTryCatch(return(expr), name, parentenv, handler)
7: tryCatchOne(expr, names, parentenv, handlers[[1L]])
6: tryCatchList(expr, classes, parentenv, handlers)
5: tryCatch(execute.experiments(experiments, scenario), error = function(e) {
       cat(sep = " ", " # Error occurred while executing targetRunner:", 
           paste0(conditionMessage(e), collapse = " "))
       result <<- FALSE
       NULL
   })
4: withCallingHandlers(tryCatch(execute.experiments(experiments, 
       scenario), error = function(e) {
       cat(sep = " ", " # Error occurred while executing targetRunner:", 
           paste0(conditionMessage(e), collapse = " "))
       result <<- FALSE
       NULL
   }), warning = function(w) {
       cat(sep = " ", " # Warning occurred while executing targetRunner:", 
           paste0(conditionMessage(w), collapse = " "))
       invokeRestart("muffleWarning")
   })
3: checkTargetFiles(scenario = scenario, parameters = parameters)
2: checkIraceScenario(scenario)
1: irace.cmdline()

# Error occurred while executing targetRunner:
!is.null(.irace$cluster) is not TRUE
An unexpected condition occurred. Please report this bug to the authors of the irace package <http://iridia.ulb.ac.be/irace>

# Check unsuccesful.

Thanks,
Bianca

messages.author: f50803d1a13ac08b
messages.subject: Re: --parallel N : An unexpected condition occurred. Please report this bug to the authors of the irace package
parts:
I'm using irace 3.3 on Windows, installed locally wrt the university server. I'm uisng irace to set the parameters of an ACO algorithm, so I' m using it at a very simple level. I followed the basic steps of the user manual:

- I created the directory  $IRACE_HOME/templates/tuning/ for the scenario setup;
- here I copied the .tmpl files, removed the .tmpl suffix and customized them;
- for the targetRunner I used the Python script you provided as example, basically without changing the main body, and I created an executable .exe from it;
- I set the scenario.txt file with the appropriate details and here I set parallel=8;
- from Windows command line I run irace.bat


Bianca

messages.author: 854a0709976c2a48
messages.subject: Re: [irace-package] Re: --parallel N : An unexpected condition occurred. Please report this bug to the authors of the irace package
parts:
Hi Bianca,

This error says that the setup for launching jobs in parallel was not properly
done. In theory, this should not happen that is why we give such an error. But
perhaps there is something special about your computer environment.

Is there any other type of error or warning in the output? Could you attach the
complete output?

Could you try with the latest version irace 3.4.1
(https://cran.r-project.org/web/packages/irace/index.html) and set debugLevel=3
(this prints extra info but it is slower) ?

Best wishes,

Manuel.

Hi, sorry to answer you after a long time. Everything's working fine with the new version.  Before I actually had version 2.1.1662 of irace and version 3.3 of R. When I tried to install the latest version of irace I had to upgrade also the version of R to a version equal or higher than 3.4. But now everything works fine. 
Thank you for your prompt response.
Bianca
